issue.title: Status of testing of Apache Airflow 3.1.7rc2 and Task SDK 1.1.7rc2
issue.body:
### Body

comments.body: My changes look good! Thanks, Ephraim!
I can confirm https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/61053 works as intended using `3.1.7rc1` git tag.
Not sure why my change related to Helm Chart is here, but it looks good.

> Not sure why my change related to Helm Chart is here, but it looks good.

It is backported to `v3-1-test`, see the link in the description of the issue, that's why it is there.
Thanks for the rc, my changes look good!
Confirming my changes (#60970) are all good. Thanks!
Having tested my change (#52040), it looks good!
Confirming my changes (https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/60877) are all good. Thanks!

The translations in the fix I made don't seem to be working. Issue #60646 Also, I had to downgrade PyJWT and SQL Alchemy to get the RC working. ``` uv pip install SQLAlchemy==2.0.46 uv pip install PyJWT==2.10.1 ```

Checked all my changes.

> Also, I had to downgrade PyJWT and SQL Alchemy to get the RC working.


This is because PyJWT breaking changes in 2.11.0 (and you likely did not use constraints when installing airflow @aaron-wolmutt -> This is already fixed by @bugraoz93  in  https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/61331 - I think we should call for RC2 with that change @ephraimbuddy, as it is basically guaranteed that anyone trying to install `3.1.7` without constraints will get this issue.

Changes look good, thanks to Amogh as well! I backported Amogh's changes after checking v3-1-test to fix the branch :) I updated, please raise if otherwise @amoghrajesh :) It is to conform to changes in the dependency, as @potiuk mentioned

All good @bugraoz93. Doesn't matter who did it as long as its done :)

Thanks for backporting that one.
There seems to be an issue with the Backport: Improve Dags Filter UI (#60346) (#60547) The changes don’t seem to be applied on my end 🥲

> There seems to be an issue with the Backport: Improve Dags Filter UI ([#60346](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/60346)) ([#60547](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/60547)) The changes don’t seem to be applied on my end 🥲 > > Came quite late :) , let's fix it in 3.1.8
Airflow 3.1.7 has been released. Thank you all for testing the release candidate!
